'''KJ-931''' was an experimental assault [[Skytrooper]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]], it was onboard the [[Eternal Flagship]] of Emperor [[Arcann]], when the Emperor received from [[SCORPIO]] the location of the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]] base of [[Odessen]] and took the flagship and a sizeable portion of the [[Eternal Fleet]] there. In the ensuing [[Battle of Odessen]] the flagship was boarded by the Alliance forces. KJ-931 encountered and engaged [[Lana Beniko]] and the [[Alliance Commander]], but was defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
KJ-931 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 16: The Battle of Odessen'''.
